title: Remittance postings reached by an approved hardship application: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, Larkfield's financial counseling team may approve a hardship application on a continence program. That approval can reach beyond the one posting the application names.

For a hardship waiver this policy handles, and only for such a waiver, an approved hardship application reaches the posting it names and, through the look-back, the program's other remittance postings this policy names; every balance adjustment other than such a hardship waiver remains under the base rule.

## Look-back terms

The look-back is judged on the waiver date, from the received date of the program's approved hardship application with the latest received date:

| Application received, counted back from the waiver date | Added to the waived amount |
|---|---|
| no more than 120 calendar days | the program's remittance postings dated within the last 6 calendar months |
| more than 120 but no more than 365 calendar days | the program's remittance postings of the latest remittance posting date, the most recent statement batch |
| more than 365 calendar days | nothing |

The named posting, when it is itself one of those remittance postings, is counted once.

A remittance posting is the patient responsibility posted from a payer's remittance. A posting is within the last 6 calendar months when it is dated fewer than 6 whole calendar months before the waiver date.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An application received 90 days ago. Remittance postings of 20.00, 35.00 and 15.00 USD lie within the last 6 months, and the named posting is the 35.00 USD one. 20.00 USD and 15.00 USD are added to the waived amount, and the named posting is counted only once.
- An application received 200 days ago. The latest remittance posting date carries two postings of 12.00 USD and 18.00 USD, and the named posting is a patient charge. Both remittance postings are added.
- An application received 120 days ago falls in the first row. One received 121 days ago falls in the second. For one received 366 days ago nothing is added.
